result.judge_notes: pass 1 (A=without, B=with): Both answers define a horizontal lockup, a stacked lockup and a mark-only version, assign one to each placement, and are organized placement by placement. A gives concrete clear-space and minimum-size numbers and a quick-reference table. B is stronger on keeping the mark readable at small sizes and on fabric: it suggests thickening the books and widening the gaps so the three books stay distinct. Their strengths offset each other overall. | pass 2 (A=with, B=without): B is the stronger answer. It sets up a clear logo kit first, gives concrete clear-space and minimum-size numbers (24 px or 0.4 in), and ends with a quick-reference table, so a volunteer could build the versions without coming back with questions. A has slightly better advice on keeping the mark readable when it's small or printed on fabric: thicker books and wider gaps so the three books stay separate. However, A only says to set a minimum size without giving one, and it gives a clear-space rule only for the header.
